title: Agent Skills SKILL.md Frontmatter Schema
description: JSON Schema for validating Agent Skills SKILL.md frontmatter. Spec: https://agentskills.io/specification

name.title: Skill Name
name.description: Short identifier for the skill. Must match parent directory name.

description.title: Skill Description
description.description: Describes what the skill does and when to use it.
examples: Extract text and tables from PDF files, fill forms, merge documents.
Analyze datasets, generate charts, and create summary reports.

license.title: License
license.description: License name or reference to a bundled license file.

compatibility.title: Compatibility
compatibility.description: Environment requirements (intended product, system packages, network access).
examples: Designed for Claude Code (or similar products)
Requires git, docker, jq, and access to the internet

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value mapping for additional metadata.

allowed-tools.title: Allowed Tools
allowed-tools.description: Space-delimited list of pre-approved tools the skill may use. Experimental.

namePattern.description: Name validation rules: lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens. Cannot start/end with hyphen. No consecutive hyphens.

examples.name: pdf-processing
examples.description: Extract text and tables from PDF files, fill PDF forms, and merge multiple PDFs. Use when working with PDF documents.

examples.name: code-review
examples.description: Performs automated code review following team standards and best practices.
examples.compatibility: Requires git and access to the repository
